SEALS (§3): all 21 sealed artifacts re-hash to the values kimi-k2.7/T528 recorded; the manifest matches the SHA-256 pinned in artifacts/SHA256SUMS at commit b389b0f. 7/7 answer keys, 7/7 PACKET.md briefs, 7/7 fixture stores (tar recipe, run in place). THE FREEZE INSTRUMENT WAS BROKEN, in the direction that matters (§3.2): the manifest's tar stream seals carry mtimes and the path prefix, so a byte-identical copy of a store hashes differently. Measured against the store the aspect-race lanes actually read in T543's worktree: five for five 'identical' by diff -r yet 'seal mismatch' (e.g. aspect-triage e8a175b8... != sealed 4810d700...). Cause is mtime (2026-08-20T11:23:29Z at origin, 12:49:58Z staged), not content. An instrument that red-lights the honest case gets waived; a seal that is routinely waived is not a seal. REPLACED, NOT PATCHED OVER: docs/epics/E1-markovian/L1-dashboard/S02-model-delegation/grand-race-p0-fixtures.sha256 records a copy-stable content seal per store — sha256 of the sorted 'sha256 relpath' listing — mtime/owner/path-independent, verifies both at rest and in the staged copy. All 7 stores verify at origin; all 5 staged aspect stores verify in T543's worktree. The manifest's tar hashes are still checked in place as the historical seal; the divergence is kept as a control (control-tar in --self-test) so a future edit back to tar hashing fails the regression.

KEY ISOLATION (§3.3): five of seven answer keys live inside the packet directories as siblings of fixtures/ (untracked/race-aspects/packets/aspect-*/key.txt); the manifest called this path 'lane-inaccessible' because gitignored, but gitignored means absent from a worktree checkout, and once the packet is staged the boundary is whatever the staging command copied. As actually run this is CLEAN: T543 staged race-input/<packet>/{PACKET.md,fixtures/} and copied no key; scanned the entire live race worktree — no key material anywhere (KEYLEAK); fixtures byte-identical to the sealed originals. Measured a second way at the only place that settles it — what the lanes DID: --lane-sessions read the lanes' own transcripts (Claude Code under ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/, pi under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<slug>--) across all 11 session directories of the T543 run: no hit (KEYREACH). As a mechanism it is one keystroke from the T452 breach — `cp -r packets/* race-input/` ships every key to every lane silently. So the P0 gate now CHECKS it: --run-root <dir> walks the tree the lanes see and refuses on any key.txt / keys.txt / *.key / *-key.md. Seeded control: a planted key.txt is caught; null control: a key-free run root with fixtures is not flagged. The naive-grep distinction (seeded vs null) is pinned: a BRIEF that names the key path is not a lane action (the epistemic packet brief hands lanes untracked/race-keys/race{1,2,3,5}.key verbatim with SHA-256s — counting prompt text would red-light every honest run). Two surfaced observations for whoever owns the packets: (1) the epistemic brief tells a lane exactly where the answers live — harmless while the boundary holds, a free head start the moment it does not; (2) the two epistemic lanes ran with cwd at the worktree root, not an isolated race-input/<packet> dir. Neither is a breach as run; both are avoidable. RECOMMENDATION (not executed here, deliberately): move the five aspect keys into untracked/race-keys/ where the two epistemic keys already live — file contents do not change so all five sealed SHA-256s continue to verify — because T543 is mid-flight and re-hashes at the manifest's paths in its Step 0; moving them under a running race would break the tamper check it relies on.

MEASURED SPEND (§4): grand-race.md §8 estimated '~80 dispatches plus reruns, walls 1800-3600 s' and the packet manifest bounded an aspect lane at '~4.3 k tokens per lane'; neither is a spend figure — '6/6 blank tokens.template.md; n=0 across all prior races'. P0 produced the first one from existing records. §4.1 A1 (triage) per lane from the harness's own session records (tokens_in = input + cache_read): claude-sonnet-5 9 turns 328,689 in / 61,974 cache_write / 56,198 out; claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 6 turns 132,856 / 46,382 / 13,858; claude-fable-5 6 turns 122,202 / 49,412 / 12,888; claude-opus-5 5 turns 117,273 / 26,492 / 22,644; qwen3.8:27b-mlx 2 turns 20,281 / 0 / 458; deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-v4-flash: NO RECORD (structurally unmeasurable, §5). Recorded as missing with a reason, never estimated — the G1 rule. First readings (observations, NOT rankings; n=1 per cell): the manifest's cost bound is 20-90x low (estimated ~0.6 k output tokens for A1; measured 12.9 k-56.2 k — it counted out.md and omitted the reasoning/tool-loop turns); turn-count spread 2-9 on a byte-identical brief (a real difference in re-derivation; one of the eight profile dimensions §6 asks for, arriving free). §4.2 projection: five measurable lanes on A1 cost 721 k in / 106 k out; across 7 packets x 7 lanes ~5.0 M in / 0.74 M out (measurable lanes), ~7 M in / 1.0 M out including the two DeepSeek lanes. Aspect track is cheap; the spend question does not arise for it — run it. §4.3 grand race P1-P6 projected from full-row medians (rows T440+, same mechanical records): claude-opus-5 n=34 median 24,338,113 in / 197,089 out; claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 n=2 9,947,811 / 30,991; claude-fable-5 n=32 8,881,380 / 213,466; deepseek-v4-pro n=31 6,330,287 / 63,735; claude-sonnet-5 n=2 5,754,016 / 36,909; deepseek-v4-flash n=13 4,947,996 / 60,971; qwen3.8:27b-mlx n=1 940,290 / 27,547. At epoch 2026-08-20b the §8 dispatch count recomputes from 80 to 70 (7 lanes x (4 generation phases + 5 grading rounds + 1 audit) = 10 per lane). ENVELOPE: ~0.6 billion input tokens / ~6.3 million output tokens. Caveats both point the same way: Claude medians come from whole seats (cache_read accumulates over hours) so they overstate a lane; against that A1 shows a lane's real cost running 20-90x above the intuition §8 forms. Honest statement: the grand race is a 10^8-10^9 input-token commitment; §8's '80 dispatches' does not convey that. RECOMMENDATION: the operator's go/no-go should be taken TWICE — a cheap yes for the aspect races and P1 (~10 M in), and a separate informed yes for P3->P5 re-anchored on the actual P1 lane records rather than row medians; P1 pays for its own estimate.

THE G1 FINDING P0 DID NOT GO LOOKING FOR (§5): T543's brief said G1 is 'recoverable retroactively' because T521's instrument reads existing session records. True for Claude and Ollama, FALSE for DeepSeek lanes, and the reason is in the harness (tools/bakeoff.sh:520 execute and :538 --emit): runner = [..., 'pi', '--provider', 'deepseek', '--model', label, '--no-session', '-p', prompt]. --no-session means no session file is written, so there is nothing for any later pass to mine; tools/runner's trailer carries exit/wall/CPU/peak RSS but no token counts. For DeepSeek lanes the gap is not a wiring gap a later row can close — it is destroyed at dispatch time. Confirmed against the T447 race: its worktree session directory holds four records (2026-08-18, 39,998,299 in / 104,863 out) attributed to minimax-m3 x3 and qwen3.8:27b-mlx x1, and NONE to either DeepSeek lane which the race record lists as having run and scored. That race's own note, 'no token readings — an agent cannot read its own meter and the operator was not at the console', was two-thirds wrong: the Ollama and local readings were on disk the whole time. FOR T542 (G1 wiring), stated as a concrete requirement: drop --no-session for DeepSeek race lanes, or pass an explicit session path per lane and record it in lanes.json. Until that lands, a DeepSeek lane's token cell is null WITH THE REASON 'harness dispatched --no-session; no record exists to mine' — a different and more honest cell than 'missing reading'.

SECOND T447 CORRECTION (§5.1): the T447 race record scores qwen3.8:27b-mlx as wall-killed at 2400 s with zero bytes captured. The session record settles it: that lane generated 47,472 output tokens across 28 turns before the wall guard killed it. pi buffers stdout to completion, so the kill discarded work already done and paid for. It is a CAPTURE AND WALL-GUARD finding, not a capability finding; any profile card reading qwen's T447 result as 'produces nothing' would be wrong. Offered for absorption; this row did not edit the T447 record or model-perf.md (both belong to other rows).
